name: Single-Leg Press
steps: Sit against the leg press pad and place the working foot in line with its hip, keeping the free foot clear.
Press the sled slightly upward to disengage the safety stops while keeping your working knee softly unlocked.
Bend your working knee and control the sled toward you, stopping before your pelvis lifts or turns.
Press through the whole foot to extend your leg, then engage the safety stops before switching legs.
tips: Keep your working knee tracking smoothly over your toes rather than drifting inward.
Avoid forcefully locking out your knee at the top of the press.
